title: Bread Omelette
description: A Mumbai street-style omelette with chopped onion, chilli and coriander cooked on a tawa and pressed between toasted bread.
steps: Beat the 3 eggs with the onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, black pepper powder and salt.
Heat half the oil on a tawa over medium heat and pour in the egg mixture, spreading it to the size of the bread.
Cook for 2 minutes until the base sets and flip once to cook the other side lightly.
Toast the bread slices in the remaining oil until golden on both sides.
Place the omelette between two slices of toast, cut in half and serve hot with ketchup.
